ios.desc:
TURN BUDGETING INTO A GAME
Bread Budgeting transforms everyday money management into a playful challenge. Set your own spending limits—or start with our ready-made templates—and keep Brad the Bread happy by staying on budget. Go overboard and Brad toasts; stay on track and each new month unlocks a fresh, collectible bread character to show off.

BUDGET TOGETHER, STAY ACCOUNTABLE
Invite a partner, roommate, or your whole friend group. Bread lets everyone share progress in real time, compare monthly goals, and cheer (or gently roast) one another. Your rarest bread achievements are displayed on a social leaderboard, so bragging rights are baked right in.

LEARN WITH BREAD UNIVERSITY
Whether you’re brand new to personal finance or fine-tuning an advanced savings plan, Bread University offers concise, practical articles curated by certified educators. Level up your money skills while Brad rises in the oven.

CONNECT YOUR BANK—NO MANUAL TYPING
Securely link your U.S. bank accounts (more regions coming soon) and import transactions automatically. Our smart categorization engine sorts every purchase so you always know where your money goes.

SEE YOUR MONEY CLEARLY
Interactive charts break down spending patterns, highlight subscriptions you may have forgotten, and display upcoming recurring charges on a calendar so nothing blindsides you at month-end.

SHOULD I BUY IT? ASK THE MAGIC EIGHT BALL
About to splurge? Shake our built-in Magic Eight Ball for a light-hearted reality check before you tap “Add to Cart.”

Bread Budgeting requires iOS 16 or later.

quotes.text:
Over the past 4 months, I have been building Bread - the gamified budgeting app. Many friends have told me that they've wanted to keep better track of their personal finance, but that the existing tools to do so (apps, websites and spreadsheets) were overly complicated for their purposes.

So I've created my first ever app, Bread Budgeting, which aims to make budgeting fun and enjoyable. It rewards good spending habits with collectible bread characters. Keeping within your budget each month will keep Brad (the anthropomorphic bread slice) alive, but go above your limits and watch him burn before your eyes.

The app also features custom categories and bank sync (for US accounts), along with AI powered automatic categorization of transactions

Let me know what you think!
